column2: Hand transcription of every cell of Tables 2 and 7 of the pinned bioRxiv v1 PDF
typed by the reviewer from the printed rows at lines 456-466 and 1006-1015, before
comparison with batch.jsonl. The 36 cells check-values could only place at row level
are the 30 Table 7 coverage cells and the 6 Table 2 cells; Table 7's Ties column is
included as well, so all 42 printed cells of the two tables are listed.
Table 2 is transcribed in its printed row order, which is not the row order of
Tables 1 and 7: it runs AlphaFold-Multimer, OpenFold3, Boltz-2, IntelliFold v2,
Protenix-v1, Protenix-v2, ascending by recovery rate.
